issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event section uses abbreviation "S1" ("B-047f delivered S1 tooling") without defining what S1 means. A reader with no prior context cannot resolve this abbreviation from the background text alone.
background.md Trigger Event section uses abbreviation "S7" ("B-6b39 fixed the S7 freeze-rule wording") without definition. S7 is never expanded anywhere in the background text.

background.md references milestone labels M0, M2, M4, M5 without inline definitions (only M1 and M3 receive brief parenthetical context). The external plan doc is cited so a reader can look them up, but standalone readability is reduced for a new-onboarded reader.
